caseNameFull: McCotter, Director, Texas Department of Corrections v. Petty

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 478 U. S. 1003.] Motion of respondent for leave to proceed further herein in forma pauperis granted. Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that John R. Breihan, Esquire, of Austin, Tex., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
